notes.title: Game Release Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear followers,

We hope you're having a fantastic Halloween night. We've got some important news to share about our game release – it's been delayed :C.

We had some hidden level ideas and wanted to make gameplay even better. To achieve this, we need a bit more time. We can't give you an exact new release date just yet, but we promise it won't be later than 2023.

We're working hard to make this game amazing, and we'll keep you updated on our progress. Thanks for your patience and understanding.

Sorry for the delay, and have a spooky and fun Halloween!
